10.1002_advs.202522315: Lithium–oxygen batteries (LOBs) are widely regarded as promising candidates for next‐generation high‐specific‐energy storage systems. However, their development is hindered by the disorderly accumulation of insulating products and sluggish oxygen redox kinetics (including ORR and OER). The rational design of high‐efficiency cathode catalysts is therefore critical for improving the overall performance of LOBs. In this work, a novel concept of interfacial dioxygen bridge coupling to design bifunctional cathode electrocatalysts derived from mining solid waste is introduced. Specifically, lattice distortion induced by oxygen vacancies, together with the intrinsic charge repulsion of Ti–O–C bonds on the (1–20) plane, cooperatively drives surface reconstruction and refines the local coordination environment. This structural adjustment consequently enhances the adsorption properties for ORR/OER, thereby improving the overall electrochemical performance. The Fine Slag/Ti 4 O 7 @TiC hybrid exhibits modified chemical bonding and remarkable stability at high rates. LOBs fabricated with the Fine Slag/Ti 4 O 7 @TiC catalyst deliver a reduced voltage polarization of only 1.42 V, ultralong cycle stability of 210 cycles at 3000 mA g −1 , and outstanding high‐rate performance (from 1000 to 10 000 mA g −1 ). DFT analysis and ex‐situ characterization further elucidate the pivotal role of interfacial dioxygen bridge coupling in governing the micro‐chemical composition and manipulating the formation pathway of Li 2 O 2 .
10.1002_eem2.70480: The growing demand for sustainable and high‐efficiency energy technologies has intensified the search for multifunctional and smart functional hydrogels capable of simultaneously harvesting, converting, and storing energy as transformative platforms at the intersection of photovoltaic, thermogalvanic, and electrochemical systems. Smart functional hydrogels offer a unique combination of mechanical flexibility, high ionic conductivity, and self‐healing capabilities within water‐rich three‐dimensional networks, transcending conventional structural functions by integrating energy frameworks where thermal management and energy conversion are effectively coupled. Thermogalvanic hydrogels convert low‐grade thermal energy into electricity while functioning as quasi‐solid electrolytes for supercapacitors. Hydrogel‐based cooling layers in thermophotovoltaic devices also enhance power conversion efficiencies and longevity, while multifunctional coatings facilitate the development of ultrathin, flexible photovoltaic modules for wearable and biomedical electronics. By hybridizing hydrogel chemistry with nanomaterials and redox‐active polymers, recent innovations have led to safe, durable, and conformable energy‐conversion and storage devices. This review explores the material science, operational mechanisms, and cutting‐edge applications of smart functional hydrogels across these interconnected domains, while discussing the challenges and future directions required to realize robust, scalable, and autonomous energy platforms.
10.1002_smll.74757: Porous organic cages are an innovative type of material used in membranes, characterized by their ability to generate high‐quality films, hierarchical porous structures, adjustable porosity, and varied functionalities. These materials with unique structures have garnered significant attention due to their ability to alter pore size in response to solvent or chemical stimuli. Here, solvent‐responsive porous organic cage‐based membrane (PCM) for heavy metal recovery and molecular sieving is demonstrated. PCM dominated membrane were fabricated on PTFE polymer support prepared from 1,3,5‐triformylbenzene and tris(4‐formylphenyl)amine in methanol as solvent at room temperature. PCM exhibits a low penetration of heavy metal ions (∼4%) and enhanced efficiency in rejecting dyes (94.5%) in water compared with methanol as a solvent. These solvent stimuli influence PCM to alter its pore size, which was confirmed using Powder X‐ray diffraction analysis. Investigations into dye removal studies revealed that the pore size of PCM decreased when the solvent transitioned from methanol to water, and this change was reversible. Moreover, the recovery of retained heavy metal ions achieving 52% recovery rate for Ni 2+ ions and 45.4% for Zn 2+ ions. This study presents the use of PCM for extracting heavy metal ions from water by adjusting the pore size via external stimuli.
10.1016_j.aosl.2026.100829: A Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF)-based hybrid system, driven by Artificial Intelligence Forecasting System (AIFS) global fields and constrained by nudging, is evaluated for one-month precipitation prediction during the 2025 South China flood period. Three downscaling experiments driven by global fields serve as benchmarks. The forecast results are verified with traditional verification and the neighborhood method. The results show that the AIFS-WRF hybrid model significantly improves the performance of precipitation forecasting from the heavy rain to extreme rainstorm magnitude. The hybrid model shares similar forecast capabilities with traditional numerical weather prediction (NWP) regional models in short-term forecasts but shows more advantages from the lead time of 4 days. The hybrid model outperforms the NWP regional models and global models with a forecast time gain of 1–2 days and 1–3 days on the heavy rain and rainstorm magnitude, respectively; and exhibits a gain of more than 4 days over the global models on the heavy rainstorm magnitude. A nudging constraint is necessary in the hybrid model. The distribution and intensity of precipitation belts forecasted by the hybrid model are improved when potential temperature is applied in the nudging constraints. 针对当前人工智能(AI)气象模型降水能力不足的问题, 本研究使用以AIFS模型数据为驱动,融入谱张弛逼近(spectral nudging)约束的WRF混合预报模式, 以提升降水预报效果.本研究在2025年华南汛期开展了为期一个月的降水预报试验, 采用传统检验方法与邻域法, 将混合模式与传统数值模式的预报结果进行对比检验.研究发现, 混合模式在大雨至特大暴雨各量级的降水预报性能均有显著提升, 并且在4天及以上预报时效中展现出明显优势.本研究证实了将AI环流场与传统数值模式相耦合的可行性, 同时为极端降水天气预报领域提供了新的思路与方向.
